boundary: Production-composed transport census: the original sender loop (cold lever, 2500 ms pacing) over production services with a census-owned TransportMetrics per condition, plus exact receiver storage of every delivered text
limitations: Android production source build on the ordinary profile; a forced-relay condition (android.e2e.performance_relay) is not part of this capability. The census reports transport mix and latency; like the original it has no latency threshold. Emulator-to-phone paths differ from the original two-phone path.
ui_driver_reason: No UI: the original census is a protocol-level sender loop. A production-owned control drives the production send use case with the original cold lever; read-only receiver storage binds delivery.
discovery_reason: manifest-owned production transport census with the original cold/warm sender loop over production services; original harness retained
reason: Additive production-composed transport census keeps the original sender loop, conditions and report; the original harness and its orchestrator remain intact.
